title: Chop Suey!
headline: System of a Down's bassist says this song was first called 'Suicide.' Then came the label.
caption:
'Chop Suey!' was the first single from System of a Down's second album, Toxicity, and it turned 25 this year.

One more detail: the song's eerie midsection borrows one of the sayings of Jesus on the cross. Serj Tankian was struggling for ideas and picked it at random from producer Rick Rubin's book collection.

And the only nod to the actual dish? A brief moment in the video where Tankian eats chop suey with some fans.

Where were you the first time you heard that 'Chop Suey!' intro?
